speaker: Doctor
text: I'm Dr. Agent, and I see you're a newborn with increasing yellowing of the eyes and skin. To understand the cause, has your baby been feeding well, and have you noticed any stool that is pale or clay-colored?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Prolonged Jaundice) with risk of cholestasis; further evaluation for biliary atresia is required given the age and feeding history. REQUEST TEST: Bilirubin (Total and Direct), Liver Function Panel, G6PD Screen. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound.
